items.title: Medtronic (MDT) Wins FDA Label Expansion After Real World Symplicity Spyral Results
items.summary: Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) reported that its Symplicity Spyral Renal Denervation system cut blood pressure meaningfully in a large real world study. The new data supported an FDA label update that widens use of Symplicity Spyral for hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and type 2 diabetes. The labeling change broadens the treated patient pool for renal denervation procedures within Medtronic's cardiovascular portfolio.
